notation.R: Decoded Z8 resource bytes. u16 reads little-endian.
notation.rz: Truncate toward zero, including negative values.
notation.I6: For unsigned coordinate t, q=t//6 and r=t%6. T[q] if r=0; otherwise ((6-r)*T[q]+r*T[q+1]+3)//6. Table domain is 0..108.

update_branch.counts_4_and_16: Return success without updating Adobe defaults.
update_branch.counts_8_and_32: Update only when TIFF IFD0 tag 700 exists. A present empty tag fails; an absent tag bypasses the update.
update_branch.limitation: The tool predicts values and parses existing XMP; it does not write image files or invoke vendor code.

A.decrypt: Standard Nikon serial/shutter-count cipher uses MakerNote 0x001d and 0x00a7; decoded bytes start at offset 4. Cipher tables are read from DLL RVAs 0x5eaa60 and 0x5eab60.
A.limitation: These offsets are exact; the semantic names of all seven bytes remain unresolved.

B.source: MakerNote 0x0023 Picture Control versions 0310 or 0311, length >=108.
B.auto_fallback: Profile index 2 with bytes 61,63,67 all 255 substitutes B20/B21/B22/B23/B24/B25/B28/B29 from offsets 90/91/94/95/96/97/98/99.
B.flexible_fallback: Profile index 14 with bytes 63,67 both 255 obtains B30/B31/B32/B33 from MakerNote 0x005c offsets 12/13/22/23; version must be 0100 or 0101 and length >=88. Otherwise these fields initialize to zero.
B.indices: C=family, I=profile index, G=resource group. AUTO0x2cf maps (2,2,2), Flexible0x20 maps (12,14,14), Creative0x801..0x814 map profile15..34 and group15; other explicit IDs are mapped in the CLI.

metadata_inputs.white_balance: First two unsigned rational values in MakerNote 0x000c, ExifTool WB_RBLevels.
metadata_inputs.sharpening_flag: 1 when MakerNote 0x0062 starts with ASCII 0100 and byte 4 equals 2; otherwise 0. Human-readable semantics remain unconfirmed.

ordered_cases: If (B30 if C==12 else B24)==1: s=0.
contrast.consumer: row=rz(s*3/64+12.5); brightness_index=6 if B26 in{1,255} else u8(B26-122); selector=R[0xa9f+13*A0+brightness_index]; contrast_term=R[0xba3+8*row+selector].

noise_coordinate.white_balance: w=max(u16(rz(512*red_ratio)),u16(rz(512*blue_ratio))); j is the first index0..4 whose R.u16[0xa82+2*j] is strictly greater than w, or5; wb_term=R[0xa8c+j].
noise_coordinate.iso: v=R[0x830+min(108,u8((iso_code-72)>>2))]. Arithmetic shift precedes uint8 narrowing and the upper-only clamp.
noise_coordinate.mode_correction: Read the frame-count-specific signed 19-knot row from the pinned DLL. q=v//6,r=v%6. If r==0, return knot[q]. Otherwise N=(6-r)*knot[q]+r*knot[q+1]; return rz(N/6) if N+3<0, else rz((N+6)/6).
noise_coordinate.rounding_note: This is not symmetric rounding: two zero adjacent knots yield +1 at a non-knot coordinate. The 8/32 rows are identical in this DLL.

noise_outputs.base: HighISO NR 0/2/4/6 selects base 0/30/45/60; other settings return failure.
noise_outputs.table_verification: Capstone extracts immediate stack stores at RVAs 0x34f0c5..0x34f4d5. RBP=RSP+0x100. Four table starts are RSP+0x13/+0xa3/+0x133/+0x1c3, each 114 bytes. All 456 bytes match the equations.

sharpening.creative_blend: If G==15,a=256 if B18==255 else u16(rz(256*(B18-128)/100)); z=u8(rz((R[0x8b2]*(256-a)+z*a)/256)). This alpha truncates while the clarity alpha rounds.
sharpening.helper: base=s8(R[0x6428a+n]); t=min(x,y). If n<12,s=base. Otherwise offset=(0x64205 if flag==1 else0x64147) when y<x, else(0x641cc if flag==1 else0x6410e); s=s8(rz(base*I6(R[offset:],t)/128)).
sharpening.table_verification: All 1024 bytes of the 256x4 LUT match. SHA256 bf90435cd150181b4cb91e38458f8d98ef0ac9c5716542917848c1407ea34591.

portable_verification.input_kind: Ordinary Z8 NEF metadata reused for synthetic pixel-shift research; not an authentic capture sequence.
portable_verification.prior_live_comparison: LuminanceSmoothing 5 and Sharpness 48 match the eight-frame synthetic vendor output documented in pixel-shift-resources.json. This verification did not execute vendor code.
portable_verification.saved_output_comparison: Root independently parsed XMP attributes and child elements from eight saved outputs: 8/32 inputs, ISO3200/3201, radial off/on. All ten predicted defaults matched in each file:80 values,zero differences. These outputs inherit the same source AUTO metadata; this is not a profile sweep.
additional_checks: Counts 8 and 32 reproduced the same ten defaults; counts 4 and 16 bypassed the update.

Twelve disposable source-metadata variants covered unsupported ColorBalance/PictureControl versions, short blocks, zero WB denominator, unsupported NR setting, absent/empty XMP, empty/truncated tag 0x62, WB int32 overflow, and empty TIFF page chain. All produced the expected CLI status.
A mismatched DLL was rejected with exit code 1 and a JSON error.
Scoped Ruff lint and formatting checks passed.
portable_verification.independent_review: A second reader independently reran the CLI, confirmed all ten known-source predictions and 1480 table bytes, and identified three malformed-input gaps. The implementation now rejects present empty/truncated tag 0x62 and WB int32 overflow, and returns JSON errors for empty TIFF page chains. All four added regression cases passed.
portable_verification.check_boundary: The 16 focused CLI cases exercise this predictor and compare two existing reported vendor defaults. They are not new Nikon runtime or Lightroom tests.

limitations: Only little-endian Nikon Z8 sources and the pinned DLL/prm/resource versions are accepted.
AUTO metadata and26 synthetic non-AUTO cases match recorded vendor defaults; see pixel-shift-adobe-matrix.json. Broader ISO, WB, profile and parameter ranges remain unverified.
Unknown Picture Control identifiers, unsupported versions, malformed blocks, and out-of-domain interpolation are rejected rather than reproducing undefined vendor memory reads.
The CLI deliberately prints only derived values, hashes, and verification counts; proprietary resource payloads and DLL tables remain external.
Authentic pixel-shift metadata and Lightroom Classic interpretation remain unverified.
